name: The Binding
summary: Carendin Halgar in the Undercity’s Magic Quarter asks you to use the Lovers’ Hearts to summon and subdue an incubus. He needs the hearts returned afterward.

sections.title: A Summoning in the Undercity
sections.body: Carendin Halgar asks for your aid in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity. The Lovers’ Hearts are to be used to summon and subdue an incubus, then brought back to him. The hearts remain in Carendin’s keeping when you return.

faq.answer: Carendin Halgar, in the Undercity’s Magic Quarter, asks for your help.

faq.q: What are the Lovers’ Hearts for?
faq.answer: You use the Lovers’ Hearts to summon and subdue an incubus.
You return the Lovers’ Hearts to Carendin Halgar in the Magic Quarter.
